note: A single loop of rustic sites in poplar forest in Police Outpost Provincial Park, about 25 km south-west of Cardston near the Montana border; a short walk to Outpost Lake (boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning station) and a trail to the playground. Bring drinking water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jul 8, 2026) and shop: 45 unserviced sites at C$24, reservable; season corrected from an approximate Apr 1 - Oct 31 (derived) to May 15 - Sep 30; max rig 51 ft (13 short sites), no pull-throughs; vault toilets, non-potable water, a dump for a fee. Not waterfront and the pin confirmed.
